none: PAS NLM-7B44A7: Roman Nummus of Helena from Kirmington
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Helena (324-341), issue of 337-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust of Helena coiffed, draped, possibly diademed right. Obverse inscription: [HELENA AVGVSTA]. Reverse description: PAX standing left holding branch [and transverse sceptre]. Reverse inscription: [PAX PVBLICA]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 13.9mm, Weight: 1.11gms, die axis: 12
